sources.deployment: Completes "On for everyone, by …": the value comes from how this copy of Socio was deployed.
sources.default: Completes "On for everyone, by …": the feature's own default value.
sources.tier: Completes "On for everyone, by …": the server's configuration for the workspace's plan (pricing tier).
sources.workspace: Completes "On for everyone, by …": the rule an admin set on this page.
value.everyone: Whether an optional feature is on for the whole workspace; {{source}} is one of sources.*. The base key is off; the on variant is on.
value.you: Whether an optional feature is on for the admin reading the page; {{source}} is one of sources.*.
roles.admin: A role, in the plural: everyone with the admin role. Also a checkbox label in the rule editor.
roles.member: A role, in the plural: everyone with the member role. Also a checkbox label in the rule editor.
targets.only: {{who}} is a list of roles (roles.*) and people's names; the list is formatted for your language.
targets.gone: Stands in for a person's name once they left the workspace.
targets.others: Added to the list in targets.only when the rule also names a role this page doesn't show.
targets.somePeople: Stands in for the whole list in targets.only when it names only roles this page doesn't show.
server.locked: {{targets}} is one of targets.*; adds that admins can't change the server's rule.
server.plan: Stands in for the plan's name in server.tierIn and server.tierOut when it's unknown.
server.tierIn: {{plan}} is the workspace's plan (pricing tier) name, such as Pro.
server.join: Joins two parts of server.line; {{next}} may itself be joined parts.
server.line: What the server's own configuration decides about a feature; {{parts}} is one or more of server.* joined by server.join.
rule.label: Heading of the editor for this workspace's own rule about a feature.
rule.who: Accessible label of the select: who has the feature under this workspace's rule.
rule.inherit: Option: no workspace rule; the feature follows the server's configuration or its default.
rule.others: Note when a stored rule names roles this page doesn't show. Option names in it are rule.on, rule.off and rule.inherit: keep them matching.
rule.people: Accessible name of the group of checkboxes, one per person.
flag.cleared: Toast after clearing a workspace rule. {{flag}} is the feature's title.
flag.issue: Label: the feature's item on the product's Improvements board, a link.
flag.owner: Label: who on the product team owns the feature (a name).
flag.removeBy: Label: the date by which the feature's switch should be removed from the code.
flag.tools: Label: the socio (AI agent) tools the feature adds; tool names are code.
pages.features.search: Accessible label of the search box on the Optional features page.
pages.features-dev.search: Accessible label of the search box on the In development page.
pages.early-access.search: Accessible label of the search box on the Early access page.
applies: Follows each page's intro. "Their" means people's; socios are AI agents, and a turn is one reply.
audit.title: Heading of the list of recent changes to features.
audit.when: A date and time in the list of recent changes.
audit.workspace: {{actor}} is the admin's name, {{flag}} the feature's key (code). The remove variant is for a cleared rule.
audit.person: An old per-person choice, no longer used. {{actor}} is the person's name, {{flag}} the feature's key (code).
audit.server: A change made by the server's configuration, naming no one. {{flag}} is the feature's key (code).
